summary: Full backend + frontend testing of himawari24 Netflix Email Access app. 20/20 backend pytest tests pass and all UI flows (login, assignments CRUD with 409 duplicate, mailbox card render, Connect Outlook 'not configured' toast, Code Search for outlook 'not_connected' result card) work as expected. Microsoft OAuth is intentionally unconfigured; all unconfigured-path behaviors verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup seed silently updates admin password on mismatch without logging - fine but consider logging.

CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' by default (CORS_ORIGINS='*') - browsers will reject credentialed requests. Not a functional issue here since frontend uses bearer tokens in localStorage, but should be tightened for production.
server.py doc.pop('_id', None) on create_assignment is defensive but insert_one already mutates doc with _id ObjectId - this is correctly excluded via pop; good.
oauth_states collection has no TTL index - abandoned states will accumulate. Consider TTL on created_at.
No pagination on /api/assignments and /api/mailboxes (limit=500). Fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed assignments per-test and delete them in the same test/teardown. One stray netflixuser@outlook.com assignment left from prior smoke tests was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering auth, config/status, categories, assignments CRUD (incl. 409 duplicate + invalid provider), mailboxes/connect 400 when MS not configured, oauth callback invalid/missing state redirects, and search outlook/not_connected + gmail/not_configured. All 20 pass. shadcn Select components (assignment-provider-select, email-assignment-select, category-select) are radix comboboxes (button+popover), NOT native <select>. To interact: click the trigger, then click the [role='option'] item. Connect Outlook shows a Sonner toast 'Microsoft OAuth is not configured yet...' - selector `li[role=status]` or `[data-sonner-toast]` works.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; nothing to RCA.
